findings.title: Mutex contention hotspot at 0x00000057d529a070
findings.summary: 1 threads waited 40 times (10/s) for mutex 0x00000057d529a070; someone was waiting 3% of the time; p99 wait 3.43 ms.
findings.qnx_note: Every MUTEX-state interval is real contention: uncontended QNX mutexes never enter the kernel. Shrink the critical section (copy outside the lock), split the lock per resource, or hand buffers between threads with message passing.

findings.title: Unusual behaviour in bm_high
findings.summary: bm_high (prio 30) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 40 of its 41 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 20 ms. It stands out in: time blocked on a mutex (higher than healthy), longest single block (higher than healthy), longest unbroken time holding a CPU (lower than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is healthy mixed workload (periodic work, a mutex and message passing), but only loosely (distance 1.18 against 0.698 typical for it): treat this as behaviour of its own.
findings.qnx_note: Learned from healthy QNX 8.0 traces: this thread behaved unlike any healthy run in the features listed. It is not a proven bug and gets no automatic fix: look at the timeline around it. Any resemblance to a known pattern is measured against labelled example windows, never a rule that fired.
